comments.author: @PlanetWonders-x9r
comments.text: This video really puts things into perspective. Clean water, reliable electricity, and basic infrastructure are things many of us take for granted, yet for these floating communities they can be daily challenges. What impressed me most is the resilience of the people—the way they adapt, support one another, and keep moving forward despite such difficult conditions. A powerful documentary that makes you think differently about what “progress” really means.
